dedupe_keys.name: 3gpp specifications free quarterly releases of the mobile standards

description: The 3GPP specifications are the technical standards for mobile networks from GSM through LTE and 5G, and the 3GPP site explains how to find them by series, release and technology area. Contents: the approved specifications, the work plan, release descriptions and technology overviews such as the 5G System overview, non-terrestrial networks, edge computing and use of 3GPP technologies by railways. Producer: 3GPP, whose Mobile Competence Centre publishes every specification as soon as possible after each Technical Specification Group plenary round; specifications are brought under change control once at least 80 percent complete. Coverage is global and technology-based, not geographic. Access: browse by series or through the 3GPP Portal, as documents; the page states the specifications are made available free of charge four times a year. Licence and cost: free to obtain, but the page read states no reuse licence. Caveats: the documents are protocol and interface standards, not network data, and are updated each round, so analysts must pin a release. Simulation uses: they define the radio, core and interface behaviour that telecom simulators and digital twins implement, supporting capacity planning and resilience studies of mobile networks. Related records include the ns-3 platform (platform-ns-3) whose radio modules implement these specifications.
